name: Instadraft
tagline: I needed SEO content for my SaaS
description: I needed SEO content for my SaaS. Solo founder, no time or budget for writers. So I hacked together a workflow with Ahrefs Starter, Claude + a Chrome extension, a custom SEO skill, and Husky AI for hosting/images. The output was good, but every post took ~60 mins of copy-pasting between tools. So I built a tool to automate the whole loop. Drop in your site, pick an article idea, and get a publish-ready post with images in one go.
